title: FancyZones CLI: set-layout crashes with InvalidOperationException on a non-numeric --monitor value

judgment.rationale: The issue is explicitly covered by an open upstream PR and an open fork mirror that modifies the affected validator. Follow that existing work rather than duplicate it.
evidence: Upstream PR #51322 explicitly closes #51317 and addresses malformed integer options in FancyZones and Image Resizer CLI: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51322
MuyuanMS/PowerToys mirror PR #1034 is open on branch pr-iterate/51322 and changes SetLayoutCommand.cs: https://github.com/MuyuanMS/PowerToys/pull/1034
Current upstream SetLayoutCommand validators call GetValueOrDefault<int?>() and GetValue(_monitor), matching the reported conversion-error path.
judgment.recommended_action: Reuse and follow PR #51322 and its existing fork mirror; do not create a competing fix or design. Keep the issue open until upstream work resolves it.

fix_assessment.rationale: Upstream PR #51322 (OPEN; updated 2026-10-15T06:41:43Z) explicitly closes this issue and changes the affected command validator. The existing MuyuanMS/PowerToys mirror PR #1034 (OPEN; updated 2026-10-18T17:29:19Z) is branch pr-iterate/51322. Links: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51322 and https://github.com/MuyuanMS/PowerToys/pull/1034. Do not duplicate this work.

issue_context.summary: The report describes a crash from a non-numeric FancyZones CLI monitor option. An open upstream PR and fork mirror already modify the affected validator and include related malformed-option coverage.
known_information: The issue provides a specific command, expected parse error, and actual unhandled exception.
The issue has no comments or attachments.
Upstream PR #51322 explicitly closes #51317, and fork mirror #1034 remains open.
inferences: The open PR likely resolves this malformed-value path, but the issue remains open until upstream work resolves it.
The PR author reports that the original suggestion to return early on parse errors is insufficient; the existing PR describes a different handling. This was not independently validated in a build.
issue_context.analysis: Current upstream source confirms custom validators read converted option values. The existing PR changes the affected command code, so a new design would duplicate work and should not repeat the issue's proposed early-return fix.
initial_investigation: Reviewed current upstream src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesCLI/CommandLine/Commands/SetLayoutCommand.cs: the --monitor validator reads a nullable integer, and the --monitor/--all validator also reads the option value.

Reviewed upstream PR #51322 and fork mirror #1034; the mirror modifies SetLayoutCommand.cs and adds CLI option tests. Validation in the PR description is author-reported and was not independently rerun.
